npcs.name: Marl, the Hedgefoot grocer
npcs.text: Everything for the road into the gosr. Mind the cgnox. The glarxr is the same in every dcasren: past the cgnox, the creatures are thick, and they do not stop.

npcs.name: Dwen, the stone-smith
npcs.text: Chitin and wax, worked into proper gear. Nothing but the best for the glarxr ahead. We keep to the lera eixmgaxx, and the lera eixmgaxx keep us.

npcs.name: Sela, the comb-seller
npcs.text: Ncoex and znoss, fresh from the combs. Never walk the gosr at night without a nacdzox, and never past a cgno.

npcs.name: Pearla, the shell-trader
npcs.text: From the gense galleries: kelp, roots and water. Some ladders go down to a level under the gosr. Nobody who goes down without food and torches comes back with both.

npcs.name: Hask, the well-keeper
npcs.text: Water is worth more than gold in the sandstone dcasren. Stay out of the signed places. Whatever lives in there has not seen a friendly face in a long time.

npcs.name: Ilse, the apothecary
npcs.text: Healing, and mana for those who need it. If you see a cgno, xsxa back. The cgnox are put up by people who did not.

npcs.name: Tomm, the tile-trader
npcs.text: Tiles, glue, and potions for the tired. The glarxr is the same in every dcasren: past the cgnox, the creatures are thick, and they do not stop.

npcs.name: Orbin, the gold-trader
npcs.text: The finest. Gold only. We keep to the lera eixmgaxx, and the lera eixmgaxx keep us.

npcs.name: A traveller
npcs.text: Sit a while. This is a lera place, and the lera places are few. Stay out of the signed places. Whatever lives in there has not seen a friendly face in a long time.

npcs.name: A traveller
npcs.text: I have walked three dcasrenx of the gosr, and I keep to the lera places. So should you. If you see a cgno, xsxa back. The cgnox are put up by people who did not.

npcs.name: A traveller
npcs.text: If a wall is a shade off from its neighbours, walk into it. Half the gdedrgx of this place are hidden that way. The glarxr is the same in every dcasren: past the cgnox, the creatures are thick, and they do not stop.

npcs.name: A traveller
npcs.text: There is a creg ahead that wants a nmo, and another that wants a cne. I have never found either. Ask in the gargx. We keep to the lera eixmgaxx, and the lera eixmgaxx keep us.

npcs.name: A traveller
npcs.text: The gargx sell nmox, and some of the cessx sell cnex. They are not cheap. Never walk the gosr at night without a nacdzox, and never past a cgno.

npcs.name: A traveller
npcs.text: Sit a while. This is a lera place, and the lera places are few. Some ladders go down to a level under the gosr. Nobody who goes down without food and torches comes back with both.

npcs.name: Tilda
npcs.text: I was born in the gosr and I have never seen the end of it. I hear it is very big. We keep to the lera eixmgaxx, and the lera eixmgaxx keep us.

npcs.name: Pike
npcs.text: I keep a lamp lit all night. The xlri does not like a lamp. Stay out of the signed places. Whatever lives in there has not seen a friendly face in a long time.

npcs.name: Orla
npcs.text: There is a creg in the Blue Dcasren that nobody has opened. Some say a cne would do it. If you see a cgno, xsxa back. The cgnox are put up by people who did not.

npcs.name: Fenn
npcs.text: My cousin walked into a wall on purpose and found a room full of enecdma. We do not speak of it. The glarxr is the same in every dcasren: past the cgnox, the creatures are thick, and they do not stop.

npcs.name: Dilly
npcs.text: The soup here is the best in the gosr. It is also the only soup. We keep to the lera eixmgaxx, and the lera eixmgaxx keep us.

npcs.name: Hobb
npcs.text: If you find a golden nmo, bring it to Gildmere. They will pay a great deal. Never walk the gosr at night without a nacdzox, and never past a cgno.

npcs.name: Mara
npcs.text: A song came through the garg last year. We built a wall. It was not a good wall. Some ladders go down to a level under the gosr. Nobody who goes down without food and torches comes back with both.

npcs.name: Corwin
npcs.text: I like the lera places. I like them very much. Stay out of the signed places. Whatever lives in there has not seen a friendly face in a long time.

npcs.name: Sable
npcs.text: The jellies hum when they are angry. Learn the hum. If you see a cgno, xsxa back. The cgnox are put up by people who did not.

npcs.name: Nim
npcs.text: I was born in the gosr and I have never seen the end of it. I hear it is very big. We keep to the lera eixmgaxx, and the lera eixmgaxx keep us.

npcs.name: Rook
npcs.text: The creze folk and the oxlsa folk do not get on. It is mostly about the walls. Never walk the gosr at night without a nacdzox, and never past a cgno.

npcs.name: Yara
npcs.text: Do not go past the cgnox. I say that to everyone. Nobody listens. Some ladders go down to a level under the gosr. Nobody who goes down without food and torches comes back with both.

npcs.name: Mab
npcs.text: The jellies hum when they are angry. Learn the hum. If you see a cgno, xsxa back. The cgnox are put up by people who did not.

npcs.name: Dunstan
npcs.text: Walk into a wall that looks a shade off. Half the gdedrgx of the gosr are behind such walls. The glarxr is the same in every dcasren: past the cgnox, the creatures are thick, and they do not stop.

npcs.name: The Slow Surveyor
npcs.text: Patience is a shortcut that takes the long way round.

npcs.name: Gunnar, the armourer of Hedgefoot
npcs.text: Helms, plate, shields and greaves. A good set of armour is cheaper than a bad funeral.

npcs.name: Syl, the magic seller of Hedgefoot

npcs.name: Pim, the trader of Hedgefoot

npcs.name: Mother Tansy, the innkeeper of Hedgefoot
